verification_method: Official page rendered in browser, Accessibilità binari expanded; numbers 1 and 2 visible under the level/ramp access category. Search extraction and unrendered HTML alone were not treated as sufficient.
interpretation: Primary-source evidence of station access provision, not a measured or mapped bus-to-train route. The frozen OSM no-steps diagnostic is incomplete for proving physical access impossibility. Availability from a station entrance does not certify the path from this design bus accost, transfer time or same-day train/platform/door conditions.
